symbols.name: DSU
symbols.description: Disjoint Set Union with path compression, union by rank, and component size

symbols.name: ShortestPathResult
symbols.description: Result of single-source shortest-path computation (dist[], prev[])

symbols.name: BridgeArtResult
symbols.description: Bridges and articulation points of an undirected graph

symbols.name: SparseGraph
symbols.description: Adjacency-list graph (directed or undirected). Algorithms: BFS, multiBFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, SPFA, 0-1 BFS, topoSort, SCC (Kosaraju + Tarjan), bridges, articulation points, Prim MST, Kruskal MST, Euler path/circuit, connectedComponents, weakConnectedComponents, isBipartite, LCA, treeDiameter, weightedTreeDiameter, negativeCycle, secondBestMST, dfsOrder

symbols.name: DenseGraph
symbols.description: Adjacency-matrix graph. Algorithms: Floyd-Warshall APSP, hasNegativeCycle, transitiveClosure

symbols.name: FlowGraph
symbols.description: Network flow graph (Dinic's algorithm). Methods: addEdge, maxFlow, minCutSide, minCutEdges

symbols.name: MCFlowGraph
symbols.description: Min-cost max-flow network (SPFA augmentation). Methods: addEdge, minCostFlow, minCostMaxFlow

symbols.name: BipartiteGraph
symbols.description: Bipartite graph with Hopcroft-Karp matching and König's min vertex cover

symbols.name: hungarianMinCost
symbols.description: Hungarian algorithm for minimum-cost perfect matching on an n×n cost matrix. O(n³)

symbols.name: TwoSAT
symbols.description: 2-SAT solver using Kosaraju SCC. Methods: addImplication, addOr, addXor, force, solve
